title: FEATURE: Multiple Carbs profiles and other food ingredients
symptom: The issue is a feature request to register multiple types of carbs, fats, and protein based on a food database from a Nightscout server, to improve blood glucose predictions. The discussion also highlights the need for both quick and comprehensive meal registration interfaces.
evidence_quote: as follow up discussion point from #1388 i will start implementing a feature to register multiple types of carbs, fats and protein (based on the food database available on a nightscout server).
